paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper sets limits on multiple couplings: ALP axioelectric g_Ae, dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, DM-electron cross section, and sterile neutrino mixing |Ue4|^2. The AxionElectron (g_Ae) limit is stated for ALP masses between 0.03 and 0.2 keV/c2 (30-200 eV) at 90% C.L., but no numerical values are given in text or tables; only described via Fig. 2. Local DM density assumed 0.3 GeV/cm^3 per Standard Halo Model.
